🎯You will be a perfect match for the Homologation team in the automotive sector if you have:
A bachelor's degree in
Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Electrical & Electronics Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related engineering field.
1–2 years of hands-on experience in
homologation, technical regulations, or product compliance
, preferably within the automotive industry.
Strong knowledge of
Turkish and European Union automotive regulations.
The ability to interpret
technical regulations
and effectively translate regulatory requirements into business processes.
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with a detail-oriented approach.
Fluency in English with excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across different departments.
The ability to work effectively with internal and external stakeholders in a dynamic business environment.
📌 Main Responsibilities:
Manage
vehicle homologation processes
in compliance with applicable regulations and company procedures.
Monitor developments in
Turkish and European Union automotive legislation
and assess their potential impact on the business.
Track company obligations related to
sustainability, connectivity, and other technical regulations
affecting vehicle compliance.
Evaluate regulatory compliance for
vehicle body modifications, conversion projects, and special-purpose vehicle applications
, while managing the required homologation and approval processes.
Support project teams in
new product development, connected vehicle technologies, sustainability initiatives, and technical development projects
from a regulatory compliance perspective.
Coordinate with
industry associations, public authorities, technical service providers, and other stakeholders
, representing the company when required.
Ensure the accuracy of vehicle data submitted to
ARTES, Revenue Administration (GİB), and other official platforms
, while monitoring related processes.
Provide
technical regulatory guidance and support
to internal departments and the dealer network.
